## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

MainActivity — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

The watch going into and out of ambient mode — nothing observes it

## Today

`AlwaysOnDisplayController.enterPowerSave` and `exitPowerSave` exist
and hold correct mode/refresh-interval logic (confirmed by
`AlwaysOnDisplayControllerTest.kt`), but nothing in `app-wear` calls
either method. `MainActivity` is a plain `ComponentActivity`; it does
not implement any ambient-mode callback, and no ambient-mode API is
wired into the module — the Wear ambient support dependency
(`androidx.wear:wear-ambient` or equivalent) is absent from
`app-wear/build.gradle.kts`, which only pulls in
`androidx.wear.compose.material` and `androidx.wear.compose.foundation`.
`AlwaysOnDisplayController` itself is never instantiated anywhere
outside its test. The race screens (`MainRacePageScreen` and its
siblings under `app-wear/.../race`) carry no power-save layout and no
ten-second refresh cadence keyed on `refreshIntervalMs` —
`SensorFreshnessWindow` is only referenced by `MainRacePageViewModel`
and by the controller itself, not by any race composable.

## Expected

`MainActivity` observes the watch entering and leaving ambient mode
(a wrist raise or a screen touch exits it) and calls
`AlwaysOnDisplayController.enterPowerSave` /
`exitPowerSave` accordingly. The current `mode` and
`refreshIntervalMs` are then made available to the active race page,
which switches to a power-save layout in `POWER_SAVE` and refreshes on
the `refreshIntervalMs` (ten-second) beat instead of continuously.
